items.t: The thing everyone is worried about is fine. The thing nobody is watching is not.
One character has solved the problem off frame and is walking back in to find everyone still panicking.
Scale joke. Something is much bigger or much smaller than it should be and nobody remarks on it.
The cat is doing exactly what a person is doing, better.
Everyone is looking in different directions and all of them are wrong.
Two people having completely different conversations and both think it is going well.
The instructions are visible and clearly say the opposite of what is happening.
Somebody is holding the item they are looking for.
A very serious face in a very silly situation.
Something has been fixed with tape in a way that should not work and does.
The reaction is enormous. The cause is tiny and visible.
One person has already left. Their mug is still warm.
An object from a previous scene is still here, in a worse state.
Repetition. The same small mistake, twice, visible in the same frame.
A perfectly ordinary thing being treated as an emergency, and an emergency being treated as ordinary.
A background character who is simply a duplicate of {4}.
Somebody has read the room and is quietly moving the breakables.
The plan is written down and is only two steps long. They are on step four.
